regulations.notes: Maui County limits STRs through Short-Term Rental Home (STRH) permits under County Code Chapter 19.65. Permits are capped per Community Plan Region — Lanai is limited to 15 permits, and Molokai has no new STRH permits being processed as of 12/31/2025. The mayor has introduced legislation to phase out STRs in apartment districts. Existing legal non-conforming STRs in resort areas may continue under different rules.
regulations.pending_legislation: Bill to phase out STRs in apartment districts introduced by Mayor Bissen
